test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. E sits third to the right of F. B sits second to the left of E. C sits second to the right of A. D sits to the immediate right of C. How many people sit between E and D, when counted from the left of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre.

E sits third to the right of F.

B sits second to the left of E.

C sits second to the right of A.

D sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d3e4bc97362bc1e813e074940d1ad85f6b21682ae13764e0ba34bab98f5c23b.png] 

So, only one person sits between E and D.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
